Build the Deutsch-Jozsa circuit for the balanced oracle f(x) = s.x mod 2 XOR 1, with s = 11 (s as an integer is 3; qubit i holds bit i of s). Use 2 input qubits (qubits 0 to 1) and one ancilla qubit (qubit 2), 3 qubits in all. Qiskit's numbering applies: qubit 0 is the least significant bit. Prepare the ancilla in |-> (X then H), put the input qubits in uniform superposition, apply the oracle as a phase kickback onto the ancilla, apply a Hadamard to every input qubit, and do not measure. The final state of the whole register must match exactly, up to global phase.
